searchText: <@!144468805697929216> left some feedback on your doc -- looks great!! i'll make another pass at this and the APIs for altair tomorrow I had a read, tried to reason about the validators and validator slices in a comment, hopefully it helps. used 400k validators as an example and didnt bother scripting to add prefix suffix markers but should be indicative sizes if i'm reading you correctly <@!680234424037670912> sync committees are capped at 1024 validators so that helps some but agree we can think about alternatives to reduce sending the list and then the same list w/ some commas ah ok, i hadn't dug so far - just saw 'validators' and thought we're creating a 210k testnet now and scaled it out - 1024 is probably small enough that we don't really care much thats probably around 12k for a set Great. Resolved most of the items, there are a few still open with questions/suggestions for how we address the issues raised. Yeah that endpoint is only going to be used by block explorers anyway, and isn't in the validating path so not too worried about the size even so (these things usually fetch the entire validators list every epoch!) There are ci/cd workflows in api repo: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs#releasing We just need somebody to pull the trigger 😄 When implementing fetch block by root from API how do we know what block version it is? Separate index root => version? at least on teku side, i'll just be loading by root, and the right one comes back... not sure about other implementations... under the covers the storage has to deal with all the ugly, and i'll have to somehow build in a check so i know how to populate the version field
